note: Floors the CI eval gate enforces per document type. A PR that drops a golden-set number below these does not merge. Set from measured baselines with a little headroom, not aspirationally: a gate that fails on noise gets disabled, and a disabled gate guards nothing.

corpus.note: The numbers below are only comparable against this corpus. The golden split is sha256(doc_id) over all documents of a type, so changing the count changes WHICH documents are graded — CI must generate exactly these.

invoice.baseline_note: Measured 97.8% single-model / 97.7% routed since Phase 3c. The euro vendor sits at 11.1% by construction (small-caps text-extraction artifact, documented in the backlog) and is deliberately not floored — flooring a known-broken field would mean either a permanently red gate or a meaningless threshold.

purchase_order.baseline_note: Measured 100% on both passes since Phase 3c.
